title: Sell or connect only approved gas appliances
what: Sell, hire, advertise or install Type A gas appliances only if approved by the Director of Energy Safety and marked or labelled as approved.

sources.title: Gas Standards Act 1972 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person shall not sell, hire, advertise for sale or install a Type A gas appliance unless the appliance — (a) is a gas appliance that is approved by the Director or is of a class or type of gas appliance that is approved by the Director; and (b) is marked, stamped or labelled in the manner approved by the Director

sources.title: Gas Standards Act 1972 (WA)

sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (version of mrdoc_47134)
sources.quote: Director means the Director of Energy Safety referred to in section 5 of the Energy Coordination Act 1994;
